# 📚 Docs or angular.io bug report

### Description

<!-- ✍️edit:--> 
Copied @gkalpak's [comments ](https://github.com/angular/angular/pull/35433#pullrequestreview-358870910)from PR #35433

> This change looks good on its own (it's an improvement over the current state), but I believe a bigger change is needed to make the example more intuitive. Things I noticed that are confusing:
> 
> A component named ListItemComponent that lists items. AFAICT, such components usually have List as a suffix, not a prefix; i.e. ItemListComponent.
> AppComponent has a property called currentItem (implying a single item) that holds a list of items (even if it happens to have only one item, it is still a list).

Originally reported issue: #35368

## 🔬 Minimal Reproduction

### What's the affected URL?**
[https://angular.io/guide/template-syntax#return-the-proper-type](https://angular.io/guide/template-syntax#return-the-proper-type)

@kapunahelewong / @gkalpak Please assign this to me, as I am already working on it.
